# A log to leave open

The third tab of [the tabs fixture](reopen-tabs-323.md).

1. Opened from Explorer, read, and left open.
2. The window was closed with the title bar's ✕.
3. Next morning another file was opened:
   - with the tabs coming back, this log was there again;
   - with them **not** coming back, it was not, and nothing of it is in
     `settings.ini`'s `[Session]`.

| When      | What was open       |
|-----------|---------------------|
| yesterday | fixture, notes, log |
| today     | the file asked for  |

> *Recent files* on the start page still names it.
